claim: TwistedMerge broadly improves ordinary model-merging accuracy
evidence_required: independent groups; fair baselines; paired positive CI
current_evidence: Selector attribution and greedy-soup comparisons are negative
strongest_safe_wording: Existing evidence does not support a broad ordinary-merge accuracy advantage
forbidden_extension: Do not claim SOTA or universal superiority
next_gate: None; this is a retained negative boundary

claim: Invertible rank-space changes preserve an individual LoRA effective update
evidence_required: unit tests at delta logit and prediction levels
current_evidence: 7 targeted tests passed; maximum well-conditioned relative delta error 1.797e-15; zero prediction disagreement
strongest_safe_wording: LoRA factors have an exact GL(r) reparameterization symmetry within the tested numerical regime
forbidden_extension: Do not turn identity into merging performance evidence
next_gate: Repeat on real adapter layers after the license gate

claim: Naive factor averaging depends on arbitrary LoRA gauges
evidence_required: fixed underlying adapters; many equivalent scrambles; measured output variation
current_evidence: 20 dense scrambles: accuracy range 0.252930; maximum relative merged-delta change 5.967; maximum logit change 9.367
strongest_safe_wording: Naive factor averaging is representation-dependent in the controlled planted adapter group
forbidden_extension: Do not generalize magnitude or performance to natural adapters
next_gate: Repeat across independent trained adapter groups

claim: Effective-delta averaging plus deterministic fixed-rank SVD is invariant to factor gauge
evidence_required: deterministic implementation; repeated scrambles; numerical tolerance
current_evidence: 20 dense scrambles: maximum relative merged-delta change 1.603e-15; maximum logit change 2.220e-15
strongest_safe_wording: Full-delta SVD is a gauge-invariant baseline in the controlled smoke
forbidden_extension: Do not imply TwistedMerge is the only invariant method
next_gate: Repeat across real adapter layers and ranks

claim: TwistedMerge factor-space alignment is invariant to well-conditioned GL(r) scrambles
evidence_required: at least 20 scrambles per family; delta and logit bounds; oracle comparison
current_evidence: 60 well-conditioned representations; global synchronization maximum dense relative merged-delta change 1.463e-14 and logit change 1.910e-14; zero primary failures
strongest_safe_wording: In one planted shared-B adapter group TwistedMerge synchronization is numerically invariant to the tested well-conditioned gauges
forbidden_extension: Do not claim arbitrary ill-conditioned invariance natural-model benefit or performance superiority
next_gate: Resolve licenses and repeat across independent trained adapter groups before any real-model claim

claim: TwistedMerge improves real adapter merge quality
evidence_required: licensed real adapters; independent training groups; frozen protocol; paired CI
strongest_safe_wording: The existing real-adapter result is negative and a new performance claim is not supported
forbidden_extension: Do not claim superiority over TIES DARE task arithmetic soups or SVD
next_gate: Resolve licenses then pass pilot and confirmatory gates

claim: Higher-order cycle defects predict harmful merges beyond pairwise similarity
evidence_required: independent adapter groups; nested validation; held-out comparison
strongest_safe_wording: This is an open Phase B question
forbidden_extension: Do not infer prediction from controlled closing cycles
next_gate: Phase A must supply diverse independent outcomes before Phase B opens

claim: Real adapter incompatibilities form natural Brauer or period-index classes
current_evidence: Existing real residual audits are negative
strongest_safe_wording: No natural Brauer or period-index claim is supported
forbidden_extension: Do not rename generic cycle inconsistency as a Brauer class

claim: TwistedMerge has validated clinical or biomedical benefit
strongest_safe_wording: No clinical validation claim is supported
forbidden_extension: Do not generalize controlled or public-benchmark results clinically
